title: Create Organization with Subdomain
description: As an event planner, I want to create an organization with a custom subdomain so that I can manage multiple events under my brand.
acceptance_criteria: User can register with email/password or OAuth (Google, Microsoft)
Organization name is validated (3-50 chars, alphanumeric + spaces)
Subdomain is checked for availability in real-time
Owner role is automatically assigned to creator
Welcome email is sent with setup instructions

title: Create Event with Type Selection
description: As a host, I want to create a new event and select its type (Wedding, Birthday, Conference, Meetup, Commemoration, Custom) so that appropriate templates and features are applied.
acceptance_criteria: Event creation wizard with step-by-step flow
Event type selector with preview thumbnails
Required fields: name, date, timezone, location/type (physical/virtual/hybrid)
Default theme is applied based on event type
Draft mode enabled until first publish

title: Dynamic Theme Application
description: As a host, I want the event page to automatically apply a theme based on event type so that it looks professional without manual design work.
acceptance_criteria: Theme JSON is loaded based on event.type field
CSS variables are injected dynamically into page
Colors, fonts, animations, patterns change per theme
Preview mode shows theme before publishing
Mobile app reflects same theme in real-time

title: Bulk Guest Import
description: As an organizer, I want to import guests from CSV/Excel so that I can quickly add hundreds or thousands of attendees.
acceptance_criteria: CSV template download with required columns (name, email, phone)
Column mapping interface for custom formats
Progress bar for large imports (10K+ rows)
Background job processing with email notification on completion

title: QR Code Generation per Guest
description: As an organizer, I want each guest to have a unique QR code so that check-in is fast, secure, and trackable.
acceptance_criteria: QR code generated on guest creation (encrypted UUID)
QR includes time-based token for anti-fraud
Bulk download all QRs as ZIP with printable sheets

title: RSVP Form Customization
description: As a host, I want to customize the RSVP form with questions specific to my event so that I collect relevant information from guests.
acceptance_criteria: Default fields: attendance status, plus-ones, dietary restrictions
Custom question builder (text, multiple choice, yes/no)
Form preview before sending to guests

title: Automated RSVP Reminders
description: As an organizer, I want automated reminders sent to non-responders so that I maximize RSVP rates without manual follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Schedule reminders (e.g., 7 days, 3 days, 1 day before deadline)
Personalized message templates per event type
Reminder analytics (open rate, click-through, response rate)
Manual trigger option for one-off reminders

title: Waitlist Management with Auto-Promotion
description: As a venue manager, I want an automated waitlist so that when capacity is reached, interested guests are queued and promoted when spots open.
acceptance_criteria: Automatic waitlist enrollment when capacity reached
Email notification to promoted guests with 48-hour response window
Waitlist position visible to guests on landing page

title: Mobile QR Check-In Scanner
description: As a check-in staff member, I want to scan guest QR codes with my mobile device so that I can quickly validate attendance even without internet.
acceptance_criteria: Camera-based QR scanner using Expo API
Offline mode with cached guest list and validation keys

title: Stripe Payment Integration for Ticket Sales
description: As an organizer, I want to sell tickets and accept payments via Stripe so that I can monetize my events seamlessly.
acceptance_criteria: Stripe Connect onboarding flow for organizations
Ticket tier creation (Early Bird, General, VIP)
Platform fee calculation and split payment
Payment confirmation email with ticket attachment

title: Real-Time Attendance Dashboard
description: As a venue manager, I want to see live attendance metrics during my event so that I can make operational decisions in real-time.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics: checked-in count, no-show count, expected arrivals

title: Event Chat Rooms
description: As a host, I want guests to communicate in event-specific chat rooms so that they can network and coordinate.
acceptance_criteria: Chat history persistence (30 days free, unlimited Pro+)

title: Photo Gallery with Moderation
description: As a host, I want guests to upload photos to a shared gallery so that everyone can access event memories.
acceptance_criteria: Uploadthing integration for secure file uploads
Cloudinary CDN for image optimization and delivery

title: Analytics Dashboard with Reports
description: As an event planner, I want comprehensive analytics so that I can measure event success and report to clients.
acceptance_criteria: RSVP funnel: invited → opened → responded → attended
Engagement metrics: chat messages, photo uploads, session attendance
Revenue tracking (ticket sales, refunds, net revenue)

title: Team Collaboration & Permissions
description: As a planning agency, I want to invite team members with specific roles so that we can collaborate securely.
acceptance_criteria: Invite by email with role assignment (Admin, Organizer, Viewer)
Activity audit log (who did what, when)
Team member removal with data reassignment

title: Multi-Language Support (i18n)
description: As an international conference organizer, I want the platform to support multiple languages so that global attendees have a localized experience.
acceptance_criteria: Supported languages: EN, ES, FR, DE, JA, PT (MVP)
Language switcher in UI (guest and organizer views)

title: Subscription Management & Billing
description: As an organization owner, I want to manage my subscription tier and billing so that I can upgrade/downgrade as needed.
acceptance_criteria: Plan comparison view (Free vs Pro vs Enterprise)

title: Seating Chart Designer
description: As a wedding host, I want to design a seating chart so that I can organize guests at tables optimally.
acceptance_criteria: Conflict detection (e.g., divorced parents at same table)

title: Recurring Event Scheduling
description: As a meetup organizer, I want to schedule recurring events so that I don't have to recreate similar events manually.
acceptance_criteria: Recurrence patterns: weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, custom
End conditions: after X occurrences, on specific date

title: Push Notifications (Mobile)
description: As a guest, I want to receive push notifications about event updates so that I stay informed in real-time.
acceptance_criteria: Notification types: RSVP reminder, event update, chat mention
Deep linking to relevant app screen

title: Self Check-In Kiosk Mode
description: As an organizer, I want to set up self-service check-in kiosks so that large crowds can check in without staff bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria: QR scan or manual code entry

title: API Access for Enterprise
description: As an enterprise client, I want API access so that I can integrate EventFlow with our internal systems.

title: White-Label Customization
description: As an agency, I want white-label branding so that my clients see my brand instead of EventFlow.

title: AI Photo Tagging
description: As a wedding host, I want AI to automatically tag people in photos so that guests can find themselves easily.
acceptance_criteria: Integration with AWS Rekognition or Google Vision

title: Donation Collection for Commemorations
description: As a memorial event organizer, I want to collect donations in lieu of gifts so that guests can contribute to meaningful causes.
acceptance_criteria: Integration with Stripe for one-time/recurring donations
Direct transfer to charities (no platform fee)
